name: Dickinson
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Dickinson, TX 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Dickinson, TX: the free Dickinson Festival of Lights at Paul Hopkins Park, nightly from November 28 to December 30, 2026.
lede: Dickinson's Christmas is the Festival of Lights, a free walk-through light show built and run by volunteers at Paul Hopkins Park.
celebrates: The Dickinson Festival of Lights Society, a nonprofit run entirely by volunteers, presents the festival each year at Paul Hopkins Park on FM 517. Admission, parking and shuttle service are free, and the society asks for donations to keep it going. The walk-through display has a giant tree, a cookie factory where kids decorate a cookie, a concession stand with hot chocolate, a Blinky Hut that sells light-up items and photos with Santa. The society also honors military service members with a tribute inside the park.
lastyear: The Dickinson Festival of Lights Society says more than 39,000 visitors came to the festival last year. The festival is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, and the society says it is put on completely by volunteers and supported by generous donations, so that families can visit at no charge. This year's 29th annual festival keeps the same park, the same free admission and the same nightly hours of 6 to 8:30 pm.
facts: This is the 29th annual Dickinson Festival of Lights. The park's giant Christmas tree stands 22 feet tall and has more than 1,600 lights programmed to put on a show every night, according to the society. A life size castle is set up for photos, the Cookie Factory lets kids decorate a cookie, and the Blinky Hut sells light-up items. The last inbound shuttle bus runs at 8:30 pm, and outbound shuttles keep running until the park is empty.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train in Dickinson this year. The closest ones are The Polar Express at the Galveston Railroad Museum and the kiddie train at Moody Gardens' Holiday in the Gardens, both on our Galveston page. A day out can also include the Galveston Railroad Museum or the Rosenberg Railroad Museum.

faq: When is the Dickinson Festival of Lights?
Nightly from November 28 to December 30, 2026, from 6 to 8:30 pm, weather permitting. It is closed December 24 and 25.
